class.name: DVChart
class.brief_description: Base chart control that manages series data, axes, legends, and overlay calculations for DataViz UI Kit charts.
class.description:
DVChart builds on [DVComponent] to provide a data-series model, chart layout helpers, legends, axes, and rich overlay support (simple/exp moving averages, Bollinger Bands). Concrete chart controls such as [DV_LineChart] or [DV_BarChart] inherit from DVChart and focus on drawing while reusing the shared data management code.
Typical usage is to configure categories, add one or more numeric series, then tweak axes or legend options. Overlays can be enabled per series to surface analytical bands without having to compute them in user code.
[b]Overlays[/b]
Overlays (SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands) are enabled per series using an [i]overlay mask[/i] that combines [enum OverlayMask] flags. Windows are expressed in samples (bars). You can either configure them after adding a series, or use the convenience method that sets everything in one call.
[codeblocks] [gdscript]
#1) Configure overlays after adding a series
var idx := add_series("Price", prices)
#Enable multiple overlays via mask
set_series_overlays(idx, DVChart.OVL_SMA | DVChart.OVL_EMA | DVChart.OVL_BBANDS)
#Per-overlay parameters (windows in bars/samples)
#SMA window (3) → Simple Moving Average over the last 3 points. set_series_sma_window(idx, 3) # SMA window
#EMA window (5) → Exponential Moving Average with smoothing factor alpha = 2/(w+1); for w=5, alpha = 2/6 ≈ 0.333…. New EMA = alpha*price + (1-alpha)*prev. set_series_ema_window(idx, 5) # EMA window
#Bollinger Bands window (3) → Rolling mean and standard deviation over the last 3 points. Bands are mid ± k * stdev. With k=2.0, that’s ±2σ around the 3-bar mean. #Bollinger k (2.0) → The standard deviation multiplier used for the bands (classic choice is 2). set_series_bbands_params(idx, 20, 2.0) # BB: window=20, k=2σ
#Optional styling per overlay
set_series_sma_style(idx, Color(0.4,0.6,0.95), 2.0) set_series_ema_style(idx, Color(0.15,0.56,0.33), 2.0) set_series_bbands_style(idx, Color(0.87,0.80,0.13), Color(0.16,0.5,0.83,0.12), 2.0)
2) Or do it in one shot when adding the series: add_series_with_overlays(name, values, overlay_mask, sma_w, ema_w, bb_w, bb_k)
var mask := DVChart.OVL_SMA | DVChart.OVL_EMA | DVChart.OVL_BBANDS var idx2 := add_series_with_overlays("Price", prices, mask, 20, 12, 20, 2.0) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]
[b]Notes[/b] • [b]overlay_mask[/b]: bitwise-OR of [constant OVL_SMA], [constant OVL_EMA], [constant OVL_BBANDS]. • [b]Windows[/b]: [method set_series_sma_window], [method set_series_ema_window], and [method set_series_bbands_params] control lengths (bars) and Bollinger multiplier k. • [b]Styling[/b]: use [method set_series_sma_style], [method set_series_ema_style], or [method set_series_bbands_style] to override overlay colors on a per-series basis. • [b]Visibility[/b]: [method set_index_range] changes which samples are drawn; overlays are computed per series and then clipped to the visible range.

method.name: set_y_tick_formatter
method.description: Replaces the text of the vertical axis labels. The callable receives the tick value and returns the string to draw — for currency, percentages, durations or dates. [codeblocks] [gdscript] chart.set_y_tick_formatter(func(v): return "$%0.2f" % v) chart.set_x_tick_formatter(func(v): return Time.get_date_string_from_unix_time(int(v))) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: set_x_tick_formatter
method.description: As [method set_y_tick_formatter], for the horizontal axis. On a category chart the labels come from [member categories] instead and this applies to numeric ticks.

method.name: is_animating
method.description: Whether a value tween is currently running. See [member DVComponent.animation_ms], which now animates every chart type rather than only the gauge and pie chart.

method.name: set_selected
method.description: Selects an item from code, emitting [signal selection_changed] as a click would. Use it to mirror a selection made elsewhere in your game, or to restore one on load. Setting the same item twice does not re-emit.

method.name: clear_selection
method.description: Clears the selection and emits [signal selection_changed] with [code]-1, -1[/code].

method.name: get_hovered_series
method.description: The series currently under the pointer, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_hovered_index
method.description: The item index currently under the pointer, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: has_palette_override
method.description: Whether series colours have been set explicitly and are therefore no longer following the theme.

method.name: reset_palette
method.description: Drops colours set with [method set_series_color] or [method set_palette] and follows the active [DVTheme] again. Explicit colours otherwise persist across theme changes.

method.name: get_x_range
method.description: The horizontal range the chart resolved, as [code](min, max)[/code]. For category charts this is the visible index window.

method.name: get_y_range
method.description: The vertical range the chart actually resolved, as [code](min, max)[/code]. With [member autoscale] on this is the padded data range; otherwise it is what [method set_min_value] and [method set_max_value] asked for. Useful for drawing your own annotations in the same space, and for asserting behaviour in tests.

method.name: add_series
method.description: Appends a data series using [param name] and [param values]. Returns the new series index so it can be configured further.

method.name: add_series_with_overlays
method.description: Adds a series and immediately applies overlay configuration. [param overlay_mask] combines the [enum OverlayMask] flags while the other parameters configure their default windows.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all categories and series data.

method.name: get_series_count
method.description: Returns the number of series currently stored.

method.name: get_series_overlays
method.description: Returns the active [enum OverlayMask] flags for the series at [param series_idx].

method.name: set_index_range
method.description: Limits the sample window processed by derived charts. Passing [-1, -1] clears the range so the whole dataset is rendered.

method.name: set_max_value
method.description: When [member autoscale] is disabled, sets the maximum values for the chart domain and value axis.

method.name: set_min_value
method.description: When [member autoscale] is disabled, sets the minimum values for the chart domain and value axis.

method.name: set_series_bbands_params
method.description: Configures Bollinger Band parameters for [param series_idx]. [param w] is the rolling window and [param k] is the standard-deviation multiplier.

method.name: set_series_bbands_style
method.description: Overrides the colors and stroke width used to render Bollinger Bands for the given series.

method.name: set_series_color
method.description: Sets the base color used for samples in the series at [param index]. Leave unset to rely on the palette provided by the active theme.

method.name: set_series_ema_style
method.description: Customizes the EMA overlay appearance using [param line] for color and [param width] for the stroke thickness.

method.name: set_series_ema_window
method.description: Sets the exponential moving average window size for the series.

method.name: set_series_name
method.description: Renames the series at [param index]. Useful when the data source changes labels at runtime.

method.name: set_series_overlays
method.description: Updates the overlay mask on [param series_idx]. Combine values from [enum OverlayMask] to enable multiple overlays.

method.name: set_series_sma_style
method.description: Overrides the SMA overlay appearance using [param line] and [param width].

method.name: set_series_sma_window
method.description: Sets the simple moving average window length for the series.

method.name: get_legend_item_rect
method.description: The rectangle the given series occupies in the legend, in this control's coordinates, or an empty [Rect2] if it has not been drawn. Useful for placing your own affordance next to a legend entry.

method.name: legend_click_at
method.description: Applies a legend click at [param local_position], as if the user had clicked there, and returns whether it landed on a legend entry. Charts call this for you; use it to route input from your own overlay or touch control. Hiding the last visible series is refused — the click is consumed but nothing changes.

method.name: set_series_values
method.description: Replaces a series' values in place, keeping its name, colour and visibility. Before 1.1 the only way to change data was [method clear] plus a full re-add, which threw those away.

method.name: set_value_at
method.description: Changes one sample. Out-of-range indices are ignored.

method.name: append_value
method.description: Appends a sample. With [param max_points] greater than zero the series keeps only the newest N, and the categories are trimmed with it so labels stay aligned — the shape a live feed wants.

method.name: remove_series
method.description: Removes a series and everything attached to it (colour override, overlays, visibility).

method.name: upsert_series
method.description: Replaces the values of the series with this name, or adds it if there is none. Useful when the data source names its series and you do not track indices.

method.name: find_series
method.description: Index of the series with this name, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_series_values
method.description: A copy of the series' values.

method.name: get_series_name
method.description: The series' name, as shown in the legend.

method.name: set_series_visible
method.description: Shows or hides a series. A hidden series is left out of the axis range as well as the drawing, so hiding an outlier rescales the chart. This is what a legend click calls; doing it from code does not emit [signal legend_item_toggled].

method.name: is_series_visible
method.description: Whether the series is currently drawn.

method.name: get_selected_series
method.description: Series of the current selection, or [code]-1[/code] when nothing is selected.

method.name: get_selected_index
method.description: Item index of the current selection, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_range_min
method.description: Low end of the value axis as it will next be drawn, resolving the layout first if the data changed. See also [method get_y_range], which returns both ends.

method.name: get_range_max
method.description: High end of the value axis as it will next be drawn.

method.name: format_axis_y
method.description: The label this chart would draw for a Y value: the tick formatter if one is set, otherwise the component's number formatting. Use it to label your own annotations the way the axis does.

method.name: format_axis_x
method.description: As [method format_axis_y], for the X axis.

method.name: get_y_tick_formatter
method.description: The callable set by [method set_y_tick_formatter], or an empty [Callable].

method.name: get_x_tick_formatter
method.description: The callable set by [method set_x_tick_formatter], or an empty [Callable].

method.name: set_min_value
method.description: Sets the low end of both axes at once, used when [member autoscale] (or [code]autoscale_x[/code]) is off. It takes both because a chart has two ranges; pass the current value for the axis you are not changing.

method.name: set_max_value
method.description: Sets the high end of both axes. See [method set_min_value].

method.name: move_selection
method.description: Moves the selection by whole steps and returns whether it moved. Hidden series are skipped, and the index is clamped to the range the chart is currently drawing. With nothing selected yet, the first call selects the first item rather than moving — the same way a list shows its cursor on the first key press. This is what the arrow keys call; use it to drive a chart from a gamepad or your own focus system.

method.name: get_item_rect
method.description: Where the item was last drawn, in this control's coordinates, or an empty [Rect2] if the chart cannot place it or has not drawn yet. Pin an annotation to a data point with this; it is also what the keyboard selection outline uses. [DV_Waterfall] and [DV_RadarGraph] do not report item rectangles, so a selection on those is not outlined.

method.name: reset_legend_position
method.description: Releases the pin set by assigning [member legend_position], so the active theme's chart style controls the legend position again.

members.member: Ordered category labels used by axis and legend layout. Leave empty for purely numeric domains.
When [code]true[/code], Y values are scaled to the data range automatically. Disable to honor [method set_min_value] and [method set_max_value].

Shows or hides chart axes and their tick labels. [b]Note:[/b] the getter is spelled [code]is_show_axese[/code]. The typo shipped in 1.0 and calling code depends on it, so it stays; prefer the property.
Tint applied to rendered axes when [member axes_visible] is enabled.
Enables a default tooltip showing category/value details when hovering data points.
Color of the background grid lines drawn across the plot.
Stroke width in pixels for grid lines.
Toggles the background grid layer behind the series.
How a value change is tweened: [constant EASE_LINEAR], [constant EASE_IN], [constant EASE_OUT] or [constant EASE_IN_OUT]. Set [code]animation_ms[/code] to 0 to draw new values immediately.
How many gridlines and labels the value axis aims for. On a log axis this is a budget: decades are thinned to fit rather than subdivided arbitrarily.
Labels on the category axis. Zero (the default) thins them to whatever fits the width; [code]1[/code] forces one label per category, [code]N[/code] every Nth.

[constant SCALE_LINEAR] (the default) or [constant SCALE_LOG]. A log axis makes several orders of magnitude readable in one chart, and turns exponential data into a straight line. On a log axis the range snaps outward to whole decades and the gridlines land on them (with 2x and 5x filled in when the range is narrow). Values at or below zero cannot be placed on one: they are clamped to the axis floor, and bars grow from that floor rather than from zero. A chart whose visible data has no positive value at all keeps its linear range instead of drawing nothing.

Where the legend sits: [constant NONE], [constant TOP], [constant BOTTOM], [constant LEFT] or [constant RIGHT]. Setting this pins the choice — the active theme's chart style no longer overrides it until [method reset_legend_position] is called.
Whether clicking a legend entry hides or shows that series. The last visible series cannot be hidden this way.
Chooses which axis represents the series values: [constant Y_AXIS] (default) or [constant X_AXIS].
Draws formatted value labels on top of rendered series when enabled.
Descriptive label rendered alongside the horizontal axis.
Descriptive label rendered alongside the vertical axis.
Overrides the chart color palette with a custom list. Leave empty to fall back to theme tokens.
Optional heading drawn above the chart content.

signal.name: item_hovered
signal.description: Emitted when the item under the pointer changes — not once per mouse-move — so it is safe to drive UI from directly. Every chart emits it, so one handler covers all of them. [signal DVComponent.hover_exited] says when to clear that UI.

signal.name: item_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when an item is clicked, or when [code]ui_accept[/code] is pressed with a keyboard selection. The chart-specific signals still fire alongside it.

signal.name: selection_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the selection moves, by click, by key or by [method set_selected]. Both values are [code]-1[/code] when the selection was cleared.

signal.name: legend_item_toggled
signal.description: Emitted when a legend click showed or hid a series. Not emitted for [method set_series_visible] called from code.

signal.name: point_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when a data point is clicked. Provides the [param series] index, [param point] index, and the data-space coordinates.

signal.name: point_hovered
signal.description: Emitted while hovering a data point. The payload matches [signal point_clicked] for consistency across components.

constants.constant: Disables all analytical overlays for a series.
Enables the simple moving average overlay.
Enables the exponential moving average overlay.
Enables Bollinger Bands for the series.
Places the legend above the plot area.
Places the legend below the plot area.
Values map to the axis in proportion to their difference. The default.
Values map by their base-10 logarithm, so equal ratios cover equal distance.
Places the legend in a column to the left of the plot area, taking at most half the chart's width.
Places the legend in a column to the right of the plot area, taking at most half the chart's width.
Series values map to the Y axis (default for vertical charts).
Series values map to the X axis (useful for horizontal charts).
Identifies the simple moving average overlay.
Identifies the exponential moving average overlay.
